Build / review item: Active high-overhead driving inspired by Slicks n Slide
Acceptance: Steering, throttle, braking and countersteering materially change line; owner approves phone handling.
Reference car on official tracks; timing report includes lap and race total, not 10–30-second total race.
No fuel, lives, wait timer, mandatory ad, paid retry, daily base-reward exhaustion or paid gate.
All gameplay-affecting cars, parts and tuning can be obtained through legitimate driving without payment; the no-paid-acceleration policy is a proposed baseline rule.
Create, validate, test, export/import and challenge; recipient never pays to play.

Build / review item: Global time histogram and performance neighbourhood
Acceptance: One best valid race per player/comparison key; rank/time neighbours, not physical geolocation.
Recurring competition with free participation; the weekly format, scoring and promotion details are proposed in the master specification.
Hosted-track allowance purchase possible; prices and free/premium quotas are proposed, not approved.
Steering + throttle/brake concurrently; adjustable zones; no throttle stuck after touch cancellation.
Match selected gameplay target at 1.15x linear scene framing; no horizon, rear chase or car-only scale; stable yaw and all-direction look-ahead tested.
Reject cuts, wrong-way line crossings, teleporting and repeated checkpoint credit; swept timing handles fast cars.

Build / review item: Standing race start and separate flying-lap record
Acceptance: Never combine lap record with full-race leaderboard; comparison key includes start mode and laps.
Ghost appearance does not alter physics; rival ghost and player share rule versions.
After load, tap-to-drivable target <=1s excluding optional initial countdown; no forced results animation.
Atomic state + journal; tests cover force-stop, full storage, corrupt current save and migration rollback.

Build / review item: Repeatable base credits and vehicle XP
Acceptance: Base rewards continue for legitimate repeated races; no day/session diminishing multiplier.
Active checkpoint progression, immutable run IDs and duration bounds; idle/repeated crossing gives no duplicate credit.
Core mechanical upgrade tree capped; mastery continues through cosmetics, badges and progression counters.
No per-adjustment fee; previously earned parts can be refitted freely; eligibility always shown.
Trial an unlocked configuration offline before spending earned credits; compare real handling, not only bars.
No code, arbitrary resources, image uploads or URLs; strict schema/size/object limits.
One route, ordered gates, minimum width/radius, bounded geometry; completion test required before publication.
Published geometry changes create new versions and records; challenge/league always pins a version hash.
Unlimited local drafts and file exchange; proposed hosted slots 5 free / 50 Creator; free recipients.
Verified app link plus code fallback; post-install flow does not depend on automatic deferred deep linking.
Key includes track version, physics/rules versions, class/spec, laps, direction, start and assists.
Unique player PBs only; invalid/pending/offline-unverified excluded; count and data age visible.
For N<20 show count/rank and individual times; do not invent a smooth histogram or percentile certainty.
Five faster + five slower where available; select eligible ghost; stable tie handling.
Three events unlocked together; retries do not add league points unless best result improves.
At least one starter-class or loaner-spec event always accessible; no consumption of entry tickets.
Season locks, validation deadline and settlement idempotency tested; disputed result process documented.
Purchases, credit grants, inventory and ranked records cannot be written as client-supplied totals.
Canonical simulation reproduces logs within contract across reference platforms; server computes official result.
Cached tracks and local progress playable; cloud credit marked pending until reconciled; no fabricated global results.
UI/domain independent of Supabase, billing provider and object store; migrations and contract tests exist.
Encrypted backups; restore drill; cost alarms; remote publishing/ranking kill switches preserve offline play.
No paid power/parts, credits, XP boost, tuning advantage, exclusive best car or extra league attempts.
Backend verifies purchase; handles pending, duplicate, restore, refund and revoked purchase; guest merge tested.
Capacity shown before editing/publication; exceeding quota preserves drafts; archive/replace does not erase progress.
Terms before upload; track/user report and block; manual moderation queue and actions; no in-game chat at launch.
No location/contact upload; account/data deletion in app and web; retention policy and age-audience review.
60fps target on declared reference phone; 20-minute thermal test; p95 frame time <=20ms, no persistent >33ms frames.
Current Play target SDK, signing/billing requirements, store tests and permissions verified before submission.
Telemetry definitions frozen; retention/creation funnel sampled honestly; no claim of commercial validation from friends alone.

Build / review item: Camera framing: car 15% larger through the camera
Acceptance: Whole scene enlarged 1.15x; camera angle and car/road ratios preserved; UI does not scale.
Selected references: matte stepped planes, selective outlines, believable car proportions; not glossy or toy-like.

Build / review item: Menu-board style without its chase cameras
Acceptance: General pages use the lower menu board; retain histogram, neighbourhood and free/earned progression.
One car/corner full-lap video, matched framing and thermal/frame-time report; no desktop-only acceptance.
Meshes and editor preview match allowlisted canonical geometry/gates; visuals do not alter verification.
Replace reference crops and branded vehicles with original or appropriately cleared assets.
